interaction drivers for npm run shot --script: each steers one page into one state before the pixels are taken
identifies its row, so other rows and files address it by this value; unique within the registry
drawn from a set and shared across rows, and the sharing is what makes it a class
resolves to a target outside the row: a path, a URL, or a key into another registry
none of the other three: the content itself, with nothing mechanical to check
one row may hold several values from the domain
one row holds at most one value from the domain
reserves a slot on every row
records only where the assertion holds

stamped by a named deriver and held to a re-derivation by a registry gate, never hand-edited. Mode sits on the declaration rather than the property, since the same property can be recorded in one scope and computed in another
authored judgment, irreplaceable, never machine-edited
a blank is legal and surfaced as a ledger figure, the count-rather-than-ban posture the computed sets run for authored judgment
optional, or filled by practice with no gate behind it
an assertion is present for every target: true of every computed field by construction, and of a recorded field a gate checks

label: Locator keys
gloss: a path in this repository; the suite checks that each one resolves, apart from exceptions it names

label: Id keys
gloss: an identifier the registry assigns or records, in one column or several together, unique within it
every non-key column must be a declared property, so an undeclared field appearing in a computed set is caught as the early symptom of an unaccounted classification

the columns are exempt from their property definitions. A smell and never a resting state: five registries were marked this way with a written reason and all five reasons were wrong, so the count is asserted at zero and adding one has to change a test

the rule is executable (a folder, an extension, the router's own table), so the row set can be derived and compared to what is there. Only this side can carry a coverage gate, because only it has something independent to check against
which targets belong is a judgment, so there is nothing to recompute; the strongest gate available is a promise-to-implementation one
